candidates.review_note: Choose which rows have no rook. All marked columns in those rows must contain a rook; remaining rows each require one. Rooks can cover one chosen row and one chosen column simultaneously, so cost is max(row count,column count), not their sum. Enumerate row subsets and union column masks in O(2^15). Supports empty board and END terminator.

Recover each bit column using declared even/odd parity; reject two unknowns or contradictory fully known parity. Parity block rotates disk=block mod d, so reconstruct data by stripe then disk excluding parity. Pad only final nibble on right and preserve leading zero hex digits. Accept documented ? and sample x corruption markers.

Maintain easiest and hardest heaps keyed by balloon count and opposite index tie-breaks. Counts change monotonically and solved flags never revert; lazy stale-entry removal gives valid extrema among unsolved tasks. Opponent solves of already completed tasks do not reinsert them. Every minute emits result, including after all tasks are solved.

The triangular AND exercise sums all subarray ANDs. For each bit, contribution counts all-one subarrays. Flipping at p creates/removes (p-left_zero)*(right_zero-p) qualifying subarrays. Fenwick order statistics over zero positions find nearest barriers; only changed bits update. Compact arrays use O(17n) storage, O(17 log n) per mutation.

Order-preserving KMP characterizes each new pattern position by an earlier equal value, or nearest lower/upper value representatives. These relations are necessary and sufficient given a matched prefix. Use identical relation checks to build failure links and scan cow values, allowing actual values to differ from rank labels while preserving ties and strict ordering. O(K*S+N).

This is a finite impartial coin-turning game where a move flips the highest chosen tail and only smaller indices. Assign each coin a Grundy weight: mex of XOR weights of the other flipped coins. Values depend only on exponents of2/3, with progression prefixes up to MAXQ. XOR weights of all tails decides outcome; no legal move at a=b0 gives weight0.

Split each ladder node into in/out with cost negative cell value. Unit source edges force one path per top cell. Three runs vary vertex and descending-edge capacities:1/1 for disjoint, m/1 for shared vertices, m/m for unrestricted. Min-cost flow reroutes residual paths and counts rewards per traversal, matching the three distinct rules.

Alternation and initial study fix activity labels; only ordered session lengths matter. Shift each length down by1 and count bounded compositions with inclusion-exclusion. Term j chooses j sessions exceeding upper bound and applies stars-and-bars to residual sum. Shared factorial/inverse tables cover all N<=1e5, including impossible N>K*M yielding0.
